label: The Beginning
text: Admizz was founded in Denver, Colorado.
impact: Founded in Denver on a single premise: preparation determines what opportunities are actually within reach.
imageAlt: A team meeting around a conference table

label: Going Global
text: Expanded globally, offering international study opportunities.
impact: The work moved from domestic to international-facing — the direction the group has built on since.
imageAlt: A city skyline silhouetted at dusk

label: A New Scale
text: Admissions support scaled beyond the founding office for the first time.
impact: Proof the model held beyond a single office — the milestone that justified building it out further.

label: Building What's Next
text: Three ventures, one purpose: helping people reach their next opportunity.
impact: Preparation, education and workforce development, now operating as three connected businesses under one group.
imageAlt: Detail of a modern glass building facade
